notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing our game![/p][p]Here are the details of this patch:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Challenge Stages Added![/b][/p][list][*][p]8 new challenge stages have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Challenge stages become available after clearing the main game.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New and Updated Stages[/b][/p][list][*][p]3 new stages have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]1 existing stage has been updated.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Faster, Clearer Combat and Feedback![/b][/p][list][*][p]The battle UI has been significantly improved.[/p][/*][/list]
